models_evaluated: general-purpose AI systems (multimodal, including fine-tuned models)
task-specific models from automated AI model generator

links.outcome: F1 of AI models versus human graders at detecting anterior capsular radial folds
links.effect: Best general-purpose AI mean F1 0.519; fine-tuned max F1 0.606, inferior to humans. Automated task-specific model F1 0.869 (AUROC 0.958); top model 0.835 matched junior specialists (0.829), below seniors.
links.quote: In head-to-head comparison with clinicians, the top automated task-specific model (F1 score, 0.835) matched the performance of junior specialists (mean F1 score, 0.829) but remained below that of senior specialists.

unlisted_practices: Using automated AI model generators to build task-specific models instead of general-purpose AI for surgical video

screen.reason: Retrospective multicenter diagnostic study comparing general-purpose vs automated task-specific AI models to human clinicians for intraoperative video detection of surgical complications without testing a deployment practice.
